preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) and len(set(a)) == n
preconditions.description: The sequence a must be a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 1000000 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes with a weight between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 2 for t in query_types)
preconditions.description: Each query type must be either 1 or 2.

postconditions.description: For each query of type 1, the output must be the sum of the distances calculated.
For each query of type 2, the sequence a must be updated by swapping the elements at positions x and x+1.

invariants.description: The length of the sequence a must remain equal to n throughout the execution.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in a)
invariants.description: All elements in the sequence a must remain within the range from 1 to n.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, _ in edges)
invariants.description: The edges must always connect distinct nodes within the range from 1 to n.
